subject: Is it possible to have a density tree where all tips are aligned?

messages.author: b5d5be0afff143c8
messages.subject: Is it possible to have a density tree where all tips are aligned?
parts:
I'm trying to emulate DensiTree plots using ggtree. Is it possible to generate a tree like this https://pbs.twimg.com/media/CNn5DgkWIAAQxmC.jpg using your program. 
I have tried the following 

library(ape)
library(ggtree)
tree = read.tree("all_par.tree") #A file with many trees
tree

p <- ggtree(tree, layout="slanted", branch.length='none', color="lightblue", alpha=.3,) + geom_tiplab(cex=1)
p

But it is clear from what I'm getting that the tips are not aligned. Even worst, I don't know if the order of the tips is maintained or if the deployed order is just the order of the first tree in the file (maybe?). 
Can I emulate that kind of plots using ggtree, i.e., have a plot where all the tips are aligned on the right and are always in the same order?

Thanks!
